text:
alice: Heads-up: repro for an org-boundary view-hydration race in console. Steps to reproduce: open Org A -> open Runs list -> click quick-switcher -> select Org B -> observe Run detail briefly flashes with Org A's run id (~150-250ms). Happens on prod-web in Chrome/Firefox. Attached a short vid: https://redwood.s3/clip.mp4

ben: I can reproduce locally. Seen it 4x in a row following the steps. Logging shows the initial GET /api/console/view?org=org-b returns the correct payload, but the UI renders previousView for a short frame before replacing it.

carla: Could be caching on the edge? Which endpoint is serving the HTML/state? Is server-side rendering sending stale state?

dave: my first guess is client hydration race: we keep previous view in memory and call hydrateState() before org context middleware finishes. The sequence seems to be: route change -> render with cached view -> fetch new context -> replace. So a tiny flash of wrong org-visible data. Not CDN.

infra-bot: deploy prod-web v3.14.2 finished at 1876543200 :white_check_mark:

alice: Pasted the minimal repro from client logs:

```
// client-router.js
useEffect(() => {
  setView(hydrateState()); // reads lastView from local store
}, [orgId, route]);

// hydrateState can return previous org-scoped view if store not cleared
```

If hydrateState() reads stale localStorage key 'lastView' which isn't namespaced by org, it will show other-org data until fetch completes.

ben: easy-fix attempt: clear view on org change before hydrate + ensure localStorage keys include orgId. Also add a tiny loading placeholder to avoid showing stale content. I'll put up a patch.

carla: Also add a server-side safeguard: include Org-ID in the SSR state envelope and assert at client-hydrate time that envelope.org === currentOrg; if mismatch, drop the envelope. That will detect similar issues.

dave: we should add telemetry first: a metric console.view.owner_mismatch with tags {expected_org, actual_org, route} and sample rate 0.01 across prod. If we see any, auto-escalate to oncall for 5xx? No, just alert to eng if >5 in 10m. I'll own the metric.

alice: Created PRs: #1234 client: clear view on org change + namespaced ls keys; #1235 edge: include orgId in cache key for /api/console/*. Pushed to canary branch and opened rollouts to 5%.

ben: Verified on canary with automated stress test (200 rapid switches) — could not reproduce. Also added unit for hydrateState to ensure org-mismatch returns null.

dave: telemetry added. Saw one owner_mismatch in canary (1876543310) which correlated with a browser extension tampering with localStorage. Root cause thus client-local in that hit. Rolling fixes to 25% now. Monitor for 30m. :eyes:

alice: Thanks all. Leaving the CDN patch in but deprioritizing. Will close this thread after 24h of clean metrics.

ben: noted. I’ll follow up on the PR review and add a short blurb in runbook about quick-switcher hazards.

carla: Awesome — nice quick triage.

dave: closing loop: alert rule console.view.owner_mismatch >5 in 10m created in Datadog. If it fires, page eng-oncall.

(Attachment: repro-video, client logs snippet)
